tables.name: hmdaz

columns.name: activity_year
columns.description: Year associated with the record; 4-digit integer such as 2018.

columns.name: lei
columns.description: Institution identifier as a string; fixed-length alphanumeric code in the sample.

columns.name: derived_msa_md
columns.description: Derived metro area/division code; integer geographic code.

columns.name: state_code
columns.description: Two-letter state code string, such as CA, MN, MI, GA, NV.

columns.name: county_code
columns.description: County geographic code as an integer.

columns.name: census_tract
columns.description: Census tract geographic identifier stored as a float; sample values appear as long tract codes.

columns.name: conforming_loan_limit
columns.description: Single-character/string loan-limit category code; sample uses C.

columns.name: derived_loan_product_type
columns.description: Derived loan product and lien combination as text, e.g. "Conventional:First Lien" or "FHA:First Lien".

columns.name: derived_dwelling_category
columns.description: Derived dwelling/property category as text, e.g. "Single Family (1-4 Units):Site-Built".

columns.name: derived_ethnicity
columns.description: Derived borrower ethnicity category as text, e.g. "Hispanic or Latino" or "Not Hispanic or Latino".

columns.name: derived_race
columns.description: Derived borrower race category as text, e.g. White or Asian.

columns.name: derived_sex
columns.description: Derived borrower sex category as text, e.g. Male.

columns.name: action_taken
columns.description: Integer code for application/loan outcome; paired with action_taken_name.

columns.name: purchaser_type
columns.description: Integer code for purchaser/investor type; paired with purchaser_type_name.

columns.name: preapproval
columns.description: Integer code indicating preapproval status; paired with preapproval_name.

columns.name: loan_type
columns.description: Integer code for loan type; paired with loan_type_name.

columns.name: loan_purpose
columns.description: Integer code for loan purpose; paired with loan_purpose_name.

columns.name: lien_status
columns.description: Integer code for lien position/status; paired with lien_status_name.

columns.name: reverse_mortgage
columns.description: Integer code indicating reverse-mortgage status; paired with reverse_mortgage_name.

columns.name: open_end_line_of_credit
columns.description: Integer indicator/code for whether the credit is an open-end line of credit.

columns.name: business_or_commercial_purpose
columns.description: Integer indicator/code for whether the loan has business or commercial purpose.

columns.name: loan_amount
columns.description: Loan amount as an integer; sample values look like whole-dollar amounts.

columns.name: loan_to_value_ratio
columns.description: Loan-to-value ratio as a float; sample values are percentages such as 96.5 or 69.23.

columns.name: interest_rate
columns.description: Interest rate as a float; sample values such as 4.5 or 5.375.

columns.name: rate_spread
columns.description: Rate spread as a float; sample values include decimals such as 1.178.

columns.name: hoepa_status
columns.description: Integer code for HOEPA-related status; paired with hoepa_status_name.

columns.name: total_loan_costs
columns.description: Total loan costs as a float; monetary amount in the sample.

columns.name: total_points_and_fees
columns.description: Total points and fees as a float; monetary amount, often null in the sample.

columns.name: origination_charges
columns.description: Origination charges as a float; monetary amount.

columns.name: discount_points
columns.description: Discount points amount as a float; often null in the sample.

columns.name: lender_credits
columns.description: Lender credits as a float; monetary amount, often null in the sample.

columns.name: loan_term
columns.description: Loan term as an integer; sample uses 360.

columns.name: prepayment_penalty_term
columns.description: Prepayment penalty term as a float; often null in the sample.

columns.name: intro_rate_period
columns.description: Introductory rate period as a float; often null in the sample.

columns.name: negative_amortization
columns.description: Integer indicator/code for negative amortization feature.

columns.name: interest_only_payment
columns.description: Integer indicator/code for interest-only payment feature.

columns.name: balloon_payment
columns.description: Integer indicator/code for balloon payment feature.

columns.name: other_nonamortizing_features
columns.description: Integer indicator/code for other non-amortizing features.

columns.name: property_value
columns.description: Property value as a float; monetary amount in the sample.

columns.name: construction_method
columns.description: Integer code for construction method.

columns.name: occupancy_type
columns.description: Integer code for occupancy type; paired with occupancy_type_name.

columns.name: manufactured_home_secured_property_type
columns.description: Integer code for manufactured-home secured property type.

columns.name: manufactured_home_land_property_interest
columns.description: Integer code for land/property interest on manufactured-home records.

columns.name: total_units
columns.description: Total property units as an integer; sample uses 1.

columns.name: multifamily_affordable_units
columns.description: Number of affordable units as a float for multifamily context; null in the sample.

columns.name: income
columns.description: Income as a float; sample values like 41, 58, 120 suggest numeric amount units not further labeled here.

columns.name: debt_to_income_ratio
columns.description: Debt-to-income ratio as a string; may be exact values like "45" or ranges like "20%-<30%".

columns.name: applicant_credit_score_type
columns.description: Integer code for applicant credit score type/source.

columns.name: co_applicant_credit_score_type
columns.description: Integer code for co-applicant credit score type/source.

columns.name: applicant_ethnicity_1
columns.description: Primary applicant ethnicity code in first position; integer, with additional positions in applicant_ethnicity_2 to applicant_ethnicity_5.

columns.name: applicant_ethnicity_2
columns.description: Second applicant ethnicity code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.description: Third applicant ethnicity code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: co_applicant_ethnicity_1

columns.name: co_applicant_ethnicity_5
columns.description: Fifth co-applicant ethnicity code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: applicant_ethnicity_observed
columns.description: Integer code indicating whether applicant ethnicity was observed/reported category status.

columns.name: co_applicant_ethnicity_observed
columns.description: Integer code indicating whether co-applicant ethnicity was observed/reported category status.

columns.name: applicant_race_1
columns.description: Primary applicant race code in first position; integer.

columns.name: applicant_race_2
columns.description: Second applicant race code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: applicant_race_3
columns.description: Third applicant race code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: applicant_race_4
columns.description: Fourth applicant race code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: applicant_race_5
columns.description: Fifth applicant race code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_1
columns.description: Primary co-applicant race code in first position.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_2
columns.description: Second co-applicant race code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_3
columns.description: Third co-applicant race code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_4
columns.description: Fourth co-applicant race code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_5
columns.description: Fifth co-applicant race code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: applicant_race_observed
columns.description: Integer code indicating whether applicant race was observed/reported category status.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_observed
columns.description: Integer code indicating whether co-applicant race was observed/reported category status.

columns.name: applicant_sex
columns.description: Applicant sex code as an integer; paired with applicant_sex_name.

columns.name: co_applicant_sex
columns.description: Co-applicant sex code as an integer; paired with co_applicant_sex_name.

columns.name: applicant_sex_observed
columns.description: Integer code indicating whether applicant sex was observed/reported category status.

columns.name: co_applicant_sex_observed
columns.description: Integer code indicating whether co-applicant sex was observed/reported category status.

columns.name: applicant_age
columns.description: Applicant age band as a string, e.g. "25-34".

columns.name: co_applicant_age
columns.description: Co-applicant age field stored as a string in schema; sample shows a sentinel-like numeric value 9999 when no co-applicant is present.

columns.name: applicant_age_above_62
columns.description: String flag for whether applicant is above age 62, e.g. "No".

columns.name: co_applicant_age_above_62
columns.description: String flag for whether co-applicant is above age 62; often null in the sample.

columns.name: submission_of_application
columns.description: Integer code for how the application was submitted.

columns.name: initially_payable_to_institution
columns.description: Integer indicator/code for whether the obligation was initially payable to the institution.

columns.name: aus_1
columns.description: First automated underwriting system code.

columns.name: aus_2
columns.description: Second automated underwriting system code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: aus_3
columns.description: Third automated underwriting system code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: aus_4
columns.description: Fourth automated underwriting system code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: aus_5
columns.description: Fifth automated underwriting system code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: denial_reason_1
columns.description: Primary denial reason code; present even in sample rows with originated loans, so treat as coded field only.

columns.name: denial_reason_2

columns.name: denial_reason_3
columns.description: Third denial reason code; float because nulls occur in sample.

columns.name: tract_median_age_of_housing_units

tables.description: Record-level mortgage or home-loan application/outcome data with institution identifier, geography, borrower demographics, loan terms, underwriting, property attributes, tract context, and paired coded/name fields for many categories.
